name: codexskills
description: Selective multi-model routing for Codex with automatic global profile reconciliation after hook trust.

interface.shortDescription: Keep six routing profiles configured after hook trust.
interface.longDescription: After you trust the bundled SessionStart hook, Codex reconciles the scout, researcher, runner, builder, strategist, and architect profiles in CODEX_HOME. Existing custom files and settings are preserved; start a new task to load changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check whether the codexskills SessionStart hook has reconciled my global routing profiles, and help resolve any warnings.
